fields.name: statementPrefix
fields.label: Statement — opening text
fields.description: Text before "Beyond the Badge" (include trailing space)

fields.name: statementLine1
fields.label: Statement — line 1 text (after brand name)
fields.description: Text after "Beyond the Badge" up to the line break (e.g. ", we believe cultural")

fields.name: statementLine2
fields.label: Statement — line 2 text
fields.description: Text on the second line (e.g. "relevance isn't earned through logos.")

fields.name: heroVideoMp4
fields.label: Hero video — MP4
fields.description: Path to the .mp4 hero video in /public (e.g. /hero.mp4). Leave blank to hide.

fields.name: heroVideoWebm
fields.label: Hero video — WebM
fields.description: Path to the .webm hero video in /public (e.g. /hero.webm). Leave blank to hide.

fields.name: quoteBefore
fields.label: Quote — opening text
fields.description: Text before the italic highlight phrase

fields.name: quoteHighlight
fields.label: Quote — highlighted phrase (italic)
fields.description: Leave blank for no highlight

fields.name: quoteAfter
fields.label: Quote — closing text
fields.description: Text after the italic phrase. A live assembled preview appears below.

fields.name: popupImages
fields.label: Full story popup images (max 5)
fields.description: Shown in the left column of the full story modal

fields.name: campaignVideoMp4
fields.label: Campaign video — MP4 path
fields.description: Leave blank to hide the Play button.

fields.name: campaignVideoWebm
fields.label: Campaign video — WebM path
fields.description: Leave blank to hide the Play button.

fields.name: campaignVideoLabel
fields.label: Campaign video — accessibility label
fields.description: e.g. "Play EON Bond film campaign video"

fields.name: marqueeItems
fields.label: Marquee items
fields.description: Services listed in the scrolling ticker tape. Character count shown per tag — aim to keep each under 32 chars.

fields.name: ctaText
fields.label: CTA link text (e.g. "Get in touch →")
fields.description: Appears bottom-left, links to the contact form.

fields.name: imagePair
fields.label: 2 — Image pair (keyword states)
fields.description: Each keyword state swaps both photos simultaneously when the user hovers a word in the hero.

fields.name: rotatingPhrases
fields.label: Tagline — rotating phrases
fields.description: Each phrase cycles in after the fixed tagline text.

fields.name: headlineMid1
fields.label: Headline — after name, before badge word
fields.description: e.g. "knows that a brand is not a"

fields.name: headlineBadgeWord
fields.label: Headline — "badge" word (no-break formatted)
fields.description: e.g. "badge—it's" — this word uses no-break formatting to prevent the em-dash splitting across lines.

fields.name: headlineMid2
fields.label: Headline — after badge word, before team size
fields.description: e.g. "a feeling. Following a decade as Global Director..."

fields.name: headlineTeamNum
fields.label: Headline — team size number (gets "+" superscript)
fields.description: Just the number, e.g. "70". The "+" and superscript formatting are applied automatically.

fields.name: headlinePost
fields.label: Headline — closing phrase
fields.description: e.g. "to redefine brand experience & culture."

fields.name: expandParagraphs
fields.label: Expanded bio paragraphs ("Read more")
fields.description: Each item is one paragraph shown when the reader clicks "Read more".

fields.name: eyebrow
fields.label: Eyebrow tag
fields.description: Small all-caps label above the heading (e.g. "GET IN TOUCH").

fields.name: headingMain
fields.label: Heading — main line
fields.description: First line of the large heading.

fields.name: headingItalic
fields.label: Heading — italic line
fields.description: Second line rendered in the italic serif font.

fields.name: subtext
fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.description: The short paragraph beneath the heading on the left side.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Phone number
fields.description: Display value shown on the page (e.g. "+4473 4202 6099"). Spaces are stripped automatically for the tel: link.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email address (shown on page)
fields.description: Email shown as a clickable link on the contact page. Should match Global Settings → Contact email.

fields.name: privacyNote
fields.label: Privacy note
fields.description: Small text shown above the submit button.

fields.name: successHeadline
fields.label: Success headline
fields.description: Large italic text shown after the form is submitted successfully.

fields.name: successSub
fields.label: Success subtext
fields.description: Smaller text shown below the success headline.

fields.name: pageTitle
fields.label: Page title (browser tab / SEO)
fields.description: Shown in the browser tab and search engine results.

fields.name: pageDescription
fields.label: Meta description (SEO)
fields.description: Used by search engines. Aim for 120–160 characters.

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
